stateRoots.title: Run state roots
stateRoots.description: Comma-separated .tickmarkr folders to read runs from; ~ and globs expand. Empty reads the session folder's own .tickmarkr.

releaseRoots.title: Release folders
releaseRoots.description: Comma-separated release folders to read the release card from; ~ and globs expand. Empty hides it.

marks.title: Harness marks
marks.description: glyph (default) draws a shape in place of each harness's name in any font. devicons draws the real logo from the Devicons icon font (devicons.io); add Devicons to your terminal's font list first, or the marks draw as empty boxes.
